subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finpath.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@finpath.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi Sophie / Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the context on FinPath's ingestion pipelines and the priority around response latency for your inline assistance use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key need: low-latency, predictable inference for document summarization and real-time suggestions within your agent UI.
- Success criteria we heard: P95 latency < 200ms for short prompts; SLOs for throughput during peak batch loads; SOC2 + audit logs for compliance.

Next step: schedule a technical deep dive/demo so our solutions engineers can walk through architecture, model latency profiles, and integration patterns. Proposed 60-min slots: 
- Tue 10/27 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 10/28 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 10/29 11:00–12:00 PT (preferred by our infra team)

If those don't work, tell me what does and I'll coordinate. I'm cc'ing Rishi (AE) who's leading the deal for visibility.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.docx (DOCX)
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finpath.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. All three proposed slots look promising for our core product team; Thu 10/29 11:00 PT is ideal for us as well. Two asks before we lock: 

1) Can you loop in your security lead to share a SOC 2 summary / answers to our quick security questionnaire? Procurement will want to review that.
2) Can you send a brief agenda for the technical deep dive (topics + attendee roles) so we know whom to include from our infra and platform teams?

Looping in Alyssa Ng (security) and Jordan (procurement) on our side — Alyssa will validate compliance docs.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Product, FinPath
sophie.turner@finpath.com

Thanks Sophie — all good, will do. Monica (cc) is our security lead and Vivek (cc) is our platform engineer who'll drive the demo. Monica — would you be able to share a 1–2 page SOC2 summary and confirm whether the shared audit evidence we provide is sufficient for FinPath's procurement?

Attached is a proposed demo agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.docx) — high level: 10m business recap, 20m architecture & latency profiles, 20m integration patterns (KV caching, routing, fallbacks), 10m Q&A + follow-ups. Please suggest edits.

We can tentatively lock Thu 10/29 11:00 PT — will wait for security/procurement confirmation and then send the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all —

Thanks for looping me in. I've attached a SOC2 summary and a short answers doc to the common questionnaire items we usually see. The attached has the control scope and where we can produce audit evidence on demand. 

High-level: SOC2 Type II in scope for security and confidentiality; we also offer audit logs/retention options and customer-managed keys for Private deployments. If procurement needs an MSA redline, we can start that in parallel — Jordan, do you want to coordinate MSA specifics with Rishi?

Availability: Thu 10/29 11:00–12:00 PT works for me and Vivek too.

Monica Patel
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
